name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel a booked appointment. Mention a cancellation fee ONLY when cancellation_fee.applicable is true in the response. Do not invent fees.
execution_message_description: Exactly one short phrase, e.g. 'One moment.' / 'Just a second.' (or Hindi: 'Ek pal.'). Never say 'cancelling', 'cancellation', or name the appointment.

caller_full_name.description: Caller full name matching the patient.
